svg.title: gdfaler / Contribution activity
svg.desc: GitHub GraphQL contribution calendar. Daily 3D columns grouped in monthly panels, read left to right. Each panel names its month or month range and shows exact first and last dates. A partial first month is combined with the next when needed to fit twelve panels. Every date appears exactly once. Zero days are flat markers. Nonzero height uses the same logarithmic scale across all panels; cap color follows GitHub contribution levels.
svg.text: Shared logarithmic height scale / cap color: GitHub activity level
